name: improve
title: improve
description: Survey any codebase as a senior advisor and produce prioritized, self-contained implementation plans for other models/agents to execute — read-only on source code, never implements anything itself.
why: The audit-first advisor loop: recon, then a 9-category parallel audit, findings vetted and prioritized by leverage, and plans written for the weakest plausible executor, executed in an isolated worktree — distinct from writing-plans (plans from a given spec) and subagent-driven-development (executes an existing plan).
